**ACCEPT** — PR #12284. One file, **+2/-4**, exactly the declared surface.

- **The description is a pure cut**: sentence one of the existing copy kept verbatim, the rest removed. 614 → 152 characters with **zero new words**. That is the strongest possible answer to a card about maintainer voice — nothing was rewritten, only stopped.
- **The title dropped the `absolute` wrapper** so the root layout's existing `%s | ObjectStack` template supplies the brand: the served page emits `Metadata framework for AI-written apps | ObjectStack`, 52 characters. Measured on the wire, not assumed, and the fallback was reasoned about too (if the template ever stopped applying, the title degrades to 38 characters — still inside every bound).
- **`AI-written` was chosen over the card's suggested `AI-built`** because `AI-written` already appears in `app/layout.tsx`'s site-wide description and `AI-built` appears **zero** times in the tree. My card would have introduced a fourth spelling alongside AI-written / AI-authored / AI-generated. Good catch, and the kind of correction I want.
- **`<h1>` byte-identical across before/after renders** (346 bytes both, one `h1` on the page) — verified against rendered HTML rather than against the file, which is the right method given #12255.
- **Third correction to my numbers this epic**: the description is **614** characters, not 615. My count included the backslash of the escaped apostrophe in the source literal. Same class of error as the fence-blind H1 grep — I have been measuring the source text where the card's claim is about the rendered text.

⚠️ **One editorial call I am flagging rather than burying**, because it is the maintainer's to veto: the new title calls ObjectStack a **"metadata framework"**, while the repo's own vocabulary elsewhere is *"the open target format and runtime"* and *"open protocol & runtime"*. The dev traded internal vocabulary for search volume — "framework" is the term people actually type — and for this card that is the defensible choice. But it is a new self-description of the product on the site's single most visible string, so: it ships unless the maintainer says otherwise, and reverting is one line.

Correction inherited from #12237's dev, recorded on the card that introduced the claim.

I wrote in the ACCEPT above that `AI-built` "appears **zero** times in the tree". That is not right: it appears **35 times across 18 files**, under `packages/objectql`, `packages/metadata-protocol` and `docs/adr/**`. It is absent from `content/docs/**` and `apps/docs/**` — presumably the surface that was actually measured, reported as the whole tree.

The decision is unaffected: `AI-written` is still the right anchor for site copy, because it is what the site itself already says (`app/layout.tsx`, and now the homepage title landed here). But it stands on **taste and consistency**, not on the word being absent from the repo, and the next card that inherits this should inherit the corrected version.
